# National Today

> > National Today is a comprehensive calendar resource celebrating national days, food holidays, awareness observances, and historical commemorations throughout the year.

The site catalogs hundreds of daily celebrations ranging from quirky food holidays (National Blueberry Muffin Day, National Cocoa Day) to serious awareness observances (International Day Against Police Brutality) and cultural traditions (Distaff Day, Transfer Day). Each entry includes historical context, celebration ideas, and cultural significance across the United States and internationally.

## Key Topics

- food holidays
- seasonal celebrations
- Wellcat holidays
- national awareness days
- cultural traditions
- historical commemorations
- United States observances
- international celebrations
- community gatherings
- health and wellness days
- culinary history
- winter and spring holidays
- professional appreciation days
- environmental awareness
- social justice observances

## Food & Culinary Holidays

- [NATIONAL BLUEBERRY MUFFIN DAY - July 11, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/national-blueberry-muffin-day): Food holiday celebrating blueberry muffins with baking history on July 11
- [NATIONAL COCOA DAY - December 13, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/national-cocoa-day): Hot cocoa celebration tracing chocolate history from Mesoamerica on Dec 13
- [NATIONAL CABBAGE DAY - February 17, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/national-cabbage-day): Vegetable celebration honoring cabbage history from North China on Feb 17
- [NATIONAL DEEP FRIED CLAMS DAY - November 1, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/national-deep-fried-clams-day): New England seafood holiday celebrating deep fried clams on November 1
- [NATIONAL AMBROSIA DAY - December 12, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/national-ambrosia-day): Southern cuisine food holiday celebrating ambrosia fruit salad on Dec 12

## Awareness & Social Observances

- [INTERNATIONAL DAY AGAINST POLICE BRUTALITY - March 15, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/international-day-against-police-brutality): Human rights activism observance addressing police misconduct on March 15
- [TENDERNESS TOWARD EXISTENCE DAY - January 19, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/tenderness-toward-existence-day): Environmental awareness day promoting conservation and compassion on Jan 19
- [NATIONAL ESCAPE DAY - January 30, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/national-escape-day): Self-care and mental health wellness observance promoting stress relief

## Seasonal & Community Celebrations

- [HOODIE HOO DAY - February 20, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/hoodie-hoo-day): Wellcat's winter celebration holiday welcoming spring on February 20
- [VISIT THE ZOO DAY - December 27, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/visit-the-zoo-day): Zoo holiday celebrating animal conservation and zoological garden history
- [MAKE YOUR DREAM COME TRUE DAY - January 13, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/make-your-dream-come-true-day): Motivational holiday for goal-setting and dream interpretation on Jan 13

## Professional & Historical Observances

- [TRANSFER DAY - March 31, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/transfer-day): U.S. Virgin Islands public holiday marking Caribbean territorial transfer
- [NATIONAL AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL DAY - July 6, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/national-air-traffic-control-day): FAA observance honoring air traffic controllers and aviation safety on July 6
- [CHIROPRACTIC FOUNDERS DAY - September 18, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/chiropractic-founders-day): Healthcare observance honoring D.D. Palmer's chiropractic founding on Sept 18
- [NATIONAL BALLPOINT PEN DAY - June 10, 2026](https://nationaltoday.com/national-ballpoint-pen-day): Writing instrument celebration honoring Bíró brothers' invention on June 10

## Cultural & Literary Traditions

- [ROBINSON CRUSOE DAY - February 1, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/robinson-crusoe-day): Literary holiday honoring Daniel Defoe's classic survival story on Feb 1
- [DISTAFF DAY - January 7, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/distaff-day): Medieval textile tradition celebrating women's spinning work on January 7
- [WORLD SKETCHNOTE DAY - January 11, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/world-sketchnote-day): Visual note-taking celebration by Mike Rohde and Sketchnote Army on Jan 11

## Quirky & Fun Holidays

- [FRUITCAKE TOSS DAY - January 3, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/fruitcake-toss-day): Quirky Manitou Springs, Colorado holiday with fruitcake throwing competition
- [BREW A POTION DAY - January 19, 2027](https://nationaltoday.com/brew-a-potion-day): Celebration of historical apothecaries and herbal medicine potions on Jan 19
